english.note: This is the all-purpose choice for evil, especially a morally wicked person, act, or plan.
Use 邪惡 as the all-purpose choice for someone or something morally evil or reprehensible.
This is the all-purpose choice for someone or something morally evil or corrupt.
Use this as the all-purpose moral description for a wicked, sinful, or morally evil person, idea, or action.
Use this for the general sense of being evil or fiend-like.
Use 邪惡 for something morally evil or wicked rather than literally black.

examples.english: That evil plan will definitely kill people.
examples.traditional: 嗰個邪惡計劃一定會害死人。
